front.title: Federation Between Capability Indexes: Crawl, Reciprocal Identification and Admission

abstract.t: Independently operated indexes of invocable capabilities do not interoperate: an agent that queries one index cannot see what another lists, and a provider must enrol with every index separately. This document specifies how such indexes find one another by following discovery documents, how an index identifies itself to the indexes it reads so that discovery is not one-directional, and an admission model that separates knowing a peer exists from indexing its catalogue, so that an open federation does not become an open injection point. It also specifies how an index may preview a peer's catalogue before admitting it. Payment, identity, reputation and invocation are out of scope. The document is offered as input to the gap analysis on federation between directories.
